capabilities: Renders headings and list items as an interactive mind map
Syncs map edits back to Markdown with line-level writes
Opens body cards to edit section text beside nodes
Rearranges branches by dragging, keyboard, or hotkeys
Exports maps to PNG, SVG, or PDF
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.7.2+; MIT licensed; README links an overview screenshot and demo but they are not included. Stores all styles and view preferences in plugin data, leaving .md files untouched.
problem: Obsidian shows an outline only as a flat heading list, with no spatial overview or visual way to rearrange sections and their paragraphs.
summary: Mind map view that renders Markdown headings as nodes with two-way sync, drag and keyboard editing, body cards, and PNG/SVG/PDF export.
